title: 创意迁移 — 美白面霜

shots.narration: 姐妹们，有没有觉得夏天晒黑了之后，皮肤就很难白回来？或者痘印、斑点总是赖着不走，整个人看起来暗沉没精神？我之前也是这样，感觉自己离‘白皙透亮’总是差那么一点点。
shots.visual_description: Influencer (looking slightly tired, bare-faced or with light makeup) sighs while looking into a mirror. The camera zooms in on small blemishes on her face, or shows a phone screen with a past photo of dull skin.

shots.narration: 直到我遇到了它！这款美白面霜，真的是我的‘救命稻草’！用了一段时间，皮肤状态简直是质的飞跃！
shots.visual_description: Influencer suddenly brightens up, smiling widely, and takes out the whitening cream from off-screen. The camera gives a close-up shot of the product.

shots.narration: 我知道你们肯定好奇效果到底有多好，光说不练假把式！我特意准备了一个‘光采魔盒’。你看，这是使用前的皮肤状态，是不是有点暗沉，还有一些小斑点？
shots.visual_description: Influencer presents a sleek, minimalist 'Radiance Light Box'. The left panel of the box lights up, clearly displaying a simulated skin texture or image with dullness and visible dark spots. Influencer gently touches the panel.

shots.narration: 但用了它之后呢？铛铛铛！你再看右边，是不是整个肤色都提亮了，那些恼人的斑点和痘印也淡化了好多，感觉皮肤都在发光！这可不是P图，是实打实的改变！
shots.visual_description: Influencer slides or opens the right panel of the light box. The right panel lights up, revealing a simulated skin texture or image that is significantly brighter, more even-toned, and with diminished spots. A clear before/after contrast is shown.

shots.narration: 它质地特别水润轻薄，一抹就吸收，完全不粘腻，敏感肌姐妹也能放心用。我每天早晚都会用，在斑点多的地方还会多涂一层，给它重点‘关照’。
shots.visual_description: Influencer opens the cream, takes a small amount on her fingertip, showcasing its creamy yet lightweight texture. She then applies it to her hand or side of her face, gently massaging until absorbed, leaving a natural glow.

shots.narration: 坚持用下来，你会发现皮肤真的变得越来越透亮，以前的暗沉不见了，连素颜都自信满满！感觉整个人的气色都提升了好几个度。
shots.visual_description: Quick cuts: Influencer confidently smiling at the camera, her skin visibly radiant; a close-up of her skin's glow in natural light; influencer gently touching her cheek with a satisfied expression.

shots.narration: 如果你也想告别暗沉，拥有那种由内而外散发的光泽肌，那这款美白面霜你真的不能错过！赶紧试试，给自己一个惊喜！
shots.visual_description: Influencer holds the cream up to her chest, smiling brightly and looking sincerely at the camera, making a recommending gesture.

shots.narration: 相信我，你一定会爱上这种白皙透亮的感觉！
shots.visual_description: Product static shot close-up with a blurred background. Influencer's hand gently rests beside the product. The frame freezes on the product and influencer's confident smile.
